verdict.rationale: Exporting data is a fair question for a cloud sandbox service, so the axis applies. However, the evidence documents no first-party export or offboarding capability. OCI image support is an input format for starting sandboxes, and S3 FUSE mounts and SDK file management are building blocks or user-side workarounds, not a documented export-all-data feature.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
